notes.title: Version1.1.0
notes.content:
-Added stage reset functionality
  You can now restart from the last checkpoint in case you get stuck or cannot proceed.
-Optimized lighting in certain areas
  Improved the balance between visibility and atmosphere.
-Adjusted mouse sensitivity settings 
  Added a safeguard to prevent the default value from being set to zero.
-Fixed an issue where the game would not end after the timer expired

This update focuses on improving comfort and stability during gameplay.
We will continue refining the experience based on your feedback. Thank you for playing!

tags.bug: -Fixed an issue where the game would not end after the timer expired
